blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Toledo-Xignex Trojans turned back former champions San Juan Predators, 13.5-7.5, to maintain their hold on second place in the Omega Division of the Philippine Chess Premier League (PCAP) Wesley So Cup on Wednesday night. The Trojans drew strength from a dominant blitz performance before holding off the Predators in the rapid round to secure the victory. Grandmaster (GM) Rogelio Barcenilla Jr. led Toledo’s charge by beating Kevin Arquero on Board 1 in the blitz round, although the two drew their rapid encounter.
